text:
carmen: Quick sync — onboarding reranker-v5 (int4 weights + fp16 acts) surfaced a consistent MRR drop on a very small-query slice (len<=3). NDCG stable elsewhere. Want to capture the convo and action items here.

ben: Can you paste the failing slice details and quant config?

carmen: slice=short_micro_v1 (n=3.1k), candidates=40, metrics=MRR@10 and NDCG@10. Quant: per-channel int4 weights, fp16 activations, calib_sample=1500 (uniform), clip_act=2.8, per-layer-scaling=true. seed float run=2025, int4 run=99.

ollie: Tokenizer parity confirmed? small tokenization shifts can be noisy for 1-3 token queries.

carmen: tokenizer parity = yes. float baseline on same harness: short_micro MRR@10=0.482, int4 MRR@10=0.442 (~-0.04). NDCG delta -0.002.

eval-bot: run 3250012360 finished. short_micro: float MRR=0.482, int4 MRR=0.442, delta=-0.040. full_eval: float 0.401 int4 0.397 delta -0.004.

ben: Looks like the error concentrates on extremely short queries. Do we have raw logit diffs for top candidates? That helps pinpoint whether specific heads/neuron directions lost.

carmen: Sample snippet:
```
query: "aws iam"
gt: "aws iam list-users"
float_logits: [gt: 3.34, runnerup: 1.02]
int4_logits:   [gt: 1.01, runnerup: 1.03]
```
Absolute drop on gt, others unaffected. Very similar to activation-clipping killing a direction rather than global rescale.

ollie: Two paths: (A) calibration underrepresents short-query activations — add short-heavy calibrations; (B) per-layer symmetric vs asymmetric scale check; (C) try bias-correction post-quant.

ben: Also try a tiny loss-aware PTQ on a short-golden mini-batch (200 examples) optimizing softmax-top1 preservation.

carmen: Plan: run 4 ablations in parallel:
  1) calibrate with short-heavy sample (50% micro-shorts)
  2) symmetric per-layer scaling ablation
  3) post-quant bias-correction pass
  4) loss-aware tiny-PTQ optimized on short_golden_200

ollie: Also bucket by candidate length and query length so we can see where shifts are strongest. And keep seeds identical across runs (use seed=2026).

eval-bot: queued runs: 3250012400 (1), 3250012410 (2), 3250012420 (3), 3250012430 (4). Will report compact numbers when done.

carmen: If any ablation restores short_micro MRR within 0.01 of float, we should add a mandatory check to the onboarding checklist: "short_micro golden set PTQ smoke". I'll draft a PR if confirmed.

ben: One more sanity: verify dedupe/filtering is identical; short queries sometimes match substr fragments and dedupe policy can rearrange topk.

carmen: Verified dedupe same. Also noticed candidate-length skews: gt often shorter than runnerups which may amplify absolute-logit sensitivity.

ollie: If bias-correct fixes it, we should consider auto-applying per-layer bias-fix for reranker family in the quant pipeline.

eval-bot: note: ensure reproducible seeds. float baseline seed=2025. Use seed=2026 for all ablation runs.

carmen: Thanks team. Will post results as a terse summary: run_id, short_micro MRR, delta_vs_float, notes. Opening onboarding PR only after one fix passes the threshold. :white_check_mark:
